name: Pall of Ashes
text: Place d3+3 ash clouds in Vilkul's CTRL until her next turn. Living enemies in them suffer -2 DEF, -2 to attack, and lose Tough; friendly models moving through them gain Pathfinder and may pass over other models.
verify: Per-cloud effects on enemies are modelled by the engine cloud logic and hook; QS verified count and LOS block.
